projectName: D-HITA RF Frontend (Passive Dual-Feed, Kapton Flex)
projectDescription: Fully passive dual-band RF frontend integrated onto the same Kapton flex substrate as the two radiating patches. The UHF patch (460 MHz) and the L-band patch (1364 MHz) are independent radiating elements, each with its own matching pad site and its own U.FL output. Both bands operate simultaneously - no switching, no MCU, no onboard power. Conformal to helmet curvature.
revision: R2 - 2026-09-28. Supersedes the active-switch revision (SKY13350 + ESP32-C3 + Li-Po on Rogers 4350B in an enclosure), which is rejected and must not be built.
plan: Two independent probe-fed patches on one shared Kapton_flex sheet (h = 3.5 mm, er = 3.5, tan d = 0.002). No shared aperture, no diplexer, no RF switch, no crossover frequency.

Each patch probe routes to a dedicated 3-position matching pad site: series position populated with a 0 ohm 0402 jumper, two shunt-to-ground positions left DNP until VNA trimming on the physical board.
Each matching site terminates in its own U.FL connector, then a 50 ohm coaxial pigtail to a ruggedized bulkhead connector routed along the helmet shell.
50 ohm microstrip trace width calculated for er = 3.5 at h = 3.5 mm; confirm against the flex fab house stackup before release.
Polyimide coverlay laminated over feed routing and matching sites ONLY - radiating patch areas must be left clear or both bands detune.
notes: dual independent feeds - both bands simultaneous
no enclosure - flex board mounts directly, external side-mounted (Design 3)
simulation validated in CST Studio - flat design complete

substrate.fabricationNote: 3.5 mm is the CST-simulated electrical thickness both bands are tuned to. Solid 3.5 mm Kapton laminate is not a stock product - realise as a thin Kapton patch/feed layer over a flexible foam or silicone spacer. OPEN FABRICATION ITEM.
substrate.rationale: Substrate THICKNESS, not material, was the dominant efficiency lever. At h = 0.2 mm the UHF patch radiated ~14% (h/lambda ~ 0.0003, ~88% of accepted power lost in the dielectric). Growing h fixed it. Rogers 4350B was rejected because it is rigid and cannot conform to helmet curvature.

boardGeometry.note: Single shared Ground + Substrate rectangle carrying both patches. Dimensions from the combined CST project.
boardGeometry.measuredIsolation_dB: -50 to -90 typical across the range; worst case -30 to -40 in the 900-1200 MHz dead zone between bands. 65 mm separation is sufficient - no redesign needed for coupling.
boardGeometry.groundPlane: PEC, zero-thickness, at Z = 0. This is also the underside RF shield required by the SIH26185 problem statement.

bands.label: UHF TO RADIO
bands.shiftNote: Resonance moved +24 MHz (+5.5%) from the 436 MHz standalone result due to coupling with the L-band patch in the combined layout. Accepted as a flagged deviation rather than re-tuning. 460 MHz is still inside the confirmed NSG/MHA UHF band of 403-470 MHz.
bands.bandSpec_MHz: 403-470 (confirmed, MHA/CRPF QRs June 2025, co-signed by NSG)
bands.bandwidth: NOT YET MEASURED - carried as known debt

bands.label: LBAND TO VIDEO
bands.shiftNote: Essentially unmoved by coupling (1363 -> 1364 MHz). Match depth degraded from standalone -24.7/-31 dB to -10.152 dB, which still meets the -10 dB target.
bands.bandSpec_MHz: 1350-1450 working assumption. Exact NSG body-worn video RF link frequency [TO BE CLARIFIED].
bands.bandwidthNote: -10 dB bandwidth ~35 MHz measured at the standalone h=3.5mm stage; clears the 28 MHz buffer floor.

nodes.name: UHF Radiating Patch
nodes.dimensions: 170.4 x 148.8 mm, zero-thickness PEC at Z = 3.5 mm
nodes.description: UHF radiating element, etched copper on the Kapton flex top layer. Probe-fed at 30 mm offset from patch centre along the resonant length. Not a purchased part.

nodes.name: UHF Probe Feed Via
nodes.description: Plated via / probe transition from the UHF patch at Z = 3.5 mm down to the ground reference at Z = 0, carrying the 50 ohm feed. Formed in the flex stackup, not a purchased part.

nodes.name: UHF Matching Pad Site
nodes.description: Three-position matching site for the 460 MHz feed. Series position populated with a 0 ohm 0402 jumper; two shunt-to-ground positions left DNP. Values determined empirically on the VNA after fabrication - NOT pre-calculated, because the simulated match is already -9.6 dB and the physical board will differ.
nodes.trimPartsToHaveOnHand: Murata LQW15A series 0402 inductors (Q > 30 at 460 MHz), Murata GRM1555 / TDK C1005 0402 C0G/NP0 capacitors. No X5R/X7R.

nodes.name: UHF Radio U.FL
nodes.description: Miniature surface-mount coaxial connector, UHF output to the handheld radio.

nodes.name: L-Band Radiating Patch
nodes.dimensions: 55.1 x 74 mm, zero-thickness PEC at Z = 3.5 mm
nodes.description: L-band radiating element, etched copper on the Kapton flex top layer, centred 250 mm from the UHF patch. Probe-fed at 16 mm offset from patch centre. Not a purchased part.

nodes.name: L-Band Probe Feed Via
nodes.description: Plated via / probe transition from the L-band patch at Z = 3.5 mm down to the ground reference at Z = 0. Formed in the flex stackup, not a purchased part.

nodes.name: L-Band Matching Pad Site
nodes.description: Three-position matching site for the 1364 MHz feed. Series position populated with a 0 ohm 0402 jumper; two shunt-to-ground positions left DNP. Trimmed on the VNA after fabrication.
nodes.trimPartsToHaveOnHand: Murata LQW15A series 0402 inductors (Q > 30 at 1364 MHz), Murata GRM1555 / TDK C1005 0402 C0G/NP0 capacitors.

nodes.name: L-Band Video U.FL
nodes.description: Miniature surface-mount coaxial connector, L-band output to the body-worn video system.

nodes.name: UHF Coax Pigtail
nodes.description: 50 ohm ruggedized coaxial pigtail, U.FL plug to bulkhead connector, routed cleanly along the helmet shell per the SIH26185 rugged-coax requirement. Length set at mechanical integration. Bulkhead connector type [TO BE CLARIFIED].

nodes.name: L-Band Coax Pigtail
nodes.description: 50 ohm ruggedized coaxial pigtail, U.FL plug to bulkhead connector.

nodes.name: Underside RF Shield / Ground Plane
nodes.dimensions: 250 x 445 mm copper plane at Z = 0
nodes.description: Continuous conductive underside layer serving as both the patch ground plane and the head-isolation shield required by the SIH26185 problem statement. Modelled as zero-thickness PEC at Z = 0 in CST. Physical material and exact geometry [TO BE CLARIFIED].

nodes.name: Polyimide Protective Coverlay
nodes.dimensions: cut to feed/matching/connector regions only - radiating patch areas MUST be left clear
nodes.description: Flexible polyimide film coverlay with acrylic adhesive protecting the feed routing, matching pad sites and U.FL terminations. Must NOT cover the radiating patch areas - added dielectric loading over a patch detunes it.

removedFromPriorRevision: Skyworks SKY13350-390LF GaAs SPDT RF switch - no longer a switched design; both bands run simultaneously through independent feeds
Espressif ESP32-C3-MINI-1-N4 MCU - no active control needed in a passive design
Nanjing Lishuan TP4056 Li-Po charger IC - no onboard power
Texas Instruments TPS63030 buck-boost regulator - no onboard power
PKCELL LP503035 Li-Po battery 3.7V 500mAh - no onboard power
ON Semi MBR0520LT1G Schottky diode - no power rail to protect
GCT USB4105-GF-A USB-C receptacle - nothing to charge or program
Murata GRM1555C1H104JA01D VDD bypass capacitor - no VDD rail exists
Yageo RC0402JR-0710KL 10k VCTL pulldown - no control line exists
Antenna Input U.FL - the patches are on this same board, so there is no external antenna input port
Rogers 4350B substrate - replaced by Kapton flex; Rogers is rigid and cannot conform to helmet curvature
60 x 40 mm board footprint and all enclosure parts (base, lid, standoffs, screws, heatsink) - the frontend is now integrated on the antenna flex sheet, no rigid case
Qorvo SPF5189Z LNA, SOT-363 footprint and bias tee - passive-only baseline, no LNA in V1
LC diplexer and 900 MHz crossover - obsolete; independent per-band feeds make a diplexer unnecessary
GPIO9 / VCTL switching logic and all firmware steps - nothing to program
